text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —My throat is parched.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
All the moisture in my mouth is drawn away.
The dry air irritates my throat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's painful, it hurts.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I don't want this breathing to stop.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I want to run through this moment with everything I have...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: It's Narita Brian! Narita Brian defeats the "Emperor" and crosses the finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~~!
Amazing, amazing, amaaa~~~zing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I got suuuuuper excited!
My heart just won't stop pounding!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If Maya beats Brian-san,
it might be even more fun!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, decided☆
I'm gonna give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...To think I would actually lose.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Look at everyone's faces.
Look at the people rejoicing at the birth of a new champion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "...How is it? The view from the top."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
…………
……I'd say "surprising", maybe.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Surprising"?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
When we were battling neck-and-neck, it was the greatest feeling in the world.
Yet right now, the moment I stood here...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—I couldn't help but wonder
what kind of thrilling race would come next.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ! ...Ah, haha!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... You still desire more, do you?
...I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Brian. There are people out there
hyping you up as the 'Successor to the Emperor.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However, you are different from me, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes, that is fine.
For that is the very path you show.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Others will learn the way by following your footsteps.
So for now... sprint ahead, as far as you can go.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I'm a bit tired, so I'm going to lie down for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Until you finish drawing up the training plan
for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Until then, lend me your lap.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Just joking. I'll just rest by myself on that chair over there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just make sure to wake me up, though.
I won't forgive you if you leave me behind.
choice_data_list: This is training for the "Arima Kinen", right?
This is training for the "Arima Kinen", right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*... Ah. Make it quick.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, listening to the sound of Narita Brian's
peaceful breathing, I began preparations for
the upcoming Arima Kinen.
